mapper.sql: a.id, a.public_id, a.conversation_id, a.question_id, a.owner_id, a.idempotency_key, a.trace_id, a.regenerated_from_answer_id, a.app_conversation_id, a.status, a.content, a.error_code, a.created_at, a.completed_at, a.cancel_reason, a.cancelled_stage, a.message_id, a.query_id, a.task_id, a.total_tokens, a.latency, a.tracing_json_str, a.intention_json_str, a.retriever_resource, a.cancel_error_code, a.cancel_requested_at, a.cancelled_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_answer (public_id, conversation_id, question_id, owner_id, idempotency_key, trace_id, regenerated_from_answer_id, status, content, created_at) VALUES (#{publicId}, #{conversationId}, #{questionId}, #{ownerId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{traceId}, #{regeneratedFromAnswerId}, #{status}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT m.content FROM qa_answer a INNER JOIN qa_message m ON m.public_id = a.question_id INNER JOIN qa_conversation c ON c.public_id = a.conversation_id WHERE a.public_id = #{id} AND c.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE qa_answer SET status = #{status}, content = #{content}, error_code = #{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE public_id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRIEVING', 'QUERYING', 'GENERATING')
